title: Liquid nitrogen made by hand docked at the Crimson War Citadel (Krynn) from nitrogen ice bought there, sold into its bid, the rest stored
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 19:10 UTC (orders ENT-083, block MERCURY: the traders left at the capitals take standing work there, docked NPC-facility crafting; rules F8, F23, F24). In place of craft-sell-argon-krynn, whose purified argon the reserve needs. The Citadel's book (table books, 18:43 UTC): nitrogen ice asked at 1 cr x 71,458, liquid nitrogen bid 1 cr x 574 (the station's). process_nitrogen_ice by hand: 5 ice -> 4 liquid nitrogen; a run costs about 5.05 cr and sells for 4 cr while the bid holds. Liquid nitrogen stands above its reserve max (pull.json: 9,909 of max 232): its sale is surplus (F24). requires.docked_at keeps it to a ship docked there; no requires.bid: what the bid does not take is stored and the route stays open. The third craft stop keeps a 20-minute docked watch (0 fuel) to halve the burn. standing: XP work. 2026-11-23 19:29 UTC (Mercury): the 20-minute watch is out again: route_run.py's desk watch calls save_book and save_board, which no line defines, so every run with watch_minutes crashed at its first poll (NameError, line 947; runs.jsonl 19:10 UTC). The fix (fleet-build copy, test red then green) waits for a clean clone (queue.log). 2026-11-23 19:34 UTC (Mercury): max_ships 12 -> 20: the cheapest craft at the Citadel, 5.05 cr a run (5 ice) and 4 cr back while the 1 cr bid holds; the oxygen craft gives it 8 ships (runs.jsonl 19:01 to 19:33 UTC). 2026-11-23 19:57 UTC (Mercury): the first stop stores the whole hold before the buy: ships came with full holds and bought 0 or 5 of 60, the workshop refused the runs and the dispatcher rested them after three short zero-credit runs (runs.jsonl 19:39 to 19:47 UTC).
